description: Reproduce a log-mel from the raw audio windows (Hann->rFFT->mel->dB) + ridge. Closed-form, no training. Waveform floor / alignment sanity check.

subject: patient1
description: PRETRAINED REFERENCE: ridge on Whisper-large encoder features (1280-dim, 30Hz aligned, ndelays=1), alpha=316228. Ceiling for the hand-written no-training mel circuits.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v16 + Oganian/Chang peakRate landmark block: sparse magnitude-weighted impulse train at local max of broadband-loudness derivative (peakRate), local min of negative derivative (peakTrough), silence-gated onset (rise after ~200ms below-baseline), plus 4.5-tau smoothed peakRate and silence_onset. +5 dim. Literature: discrete event-train beats continuous envelope for middle-STG.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v16 + speaker-normalized (z-scored) log-F0 block (Chang Science 2017). Voicing-gated (sigmoid of pitch strength) running mean and std of log_f0 with two long taus (90, 200 frames = 3-6.7s = speaker scale). Per tau: z, dz, +dz, -dz (4 dim). Total +8 dim. v17 (peakRate, +5 dim) gave +0.0001 and was removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v16 + power-law (scale-free) adaptation block: long log-cochleagram minus two power-law-smoothed contexts k[t]=(t+t0)^-beta. beta=0.7 L=180 (6s) and beta=0.4 L=300 (10s) — multi-scale context without a single characteristic tau, distinct from the existing fixed-tau EMAs. +40 dim. Literature: STG adapts at multi-second scales with power-law dynamics. v17/v18 removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v16 + lateral-inhibition (DoG/Mexican-hat) across the 20-channel long log-cochleagram at two scales (sigma_c=0.5/2.0, sigma_c=1.0/4.0), plus their rectified temporal onsets. +80 dim. Classical cochlear/IC sharpening prior NOT in v16. v17 (peakRate +0.0001), v18 (pitch-z +0.0001), v19 (power-law +0.0002) removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v16 + voicing-modulated nonlinear interactions. Ridge is linear, so products of features it cannot construct. Provide: phon*v, phon*(1-v), formants*v, mom*v, flat*(1-v), flux*(1-v), plus voicing trace & deriv. +34 dim. v17-v20 below noise floor and removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v22 + 2D spectro-temporal contrast block: separable Gaussian smoothing in (t, f) at 3 scales (sigma_t,sigma_f)=(3,1.5),(9,3),(30,5), output (log_e_long - 2Dsmooth) and ReLU(+/-) per pair. +180 dim. Distinct from v20 (channel-only DoG) and from existing temporal subtract. v17-v21 all at noise floor and removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v22 + utterance-scale (300, 600 frames = 10s, 20s) deviation-from-mean features on 7 key 1-D signals (long_loud, long_centroid, log_f0, best_strength, hnr_db, flat, flux_abs). +14 dim. Captures speaker/utterance state context beyond existing 60/150 frame taus. v17-v21 + v23 all at or below noise floor and removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v22 + multi-lag spectral flux (klag=2,4,8 frames) on long log-cochleagram: pos, neg, abs sums per lag. +9 dim. Probes slower modulation rates than the existing 1-frame flux. v17-v21, v23-v24 all at or below noise floor and removed.

subject: patient1
description: Baseline check: LEAN v22 with no added blocks. Verifying dim count and test_corr after recent runs showed dim drop. v17-v21, v23-v25 all hurt or noise-floor and removed.

subject: patient1
description: v26: RESTORED v16's future+past per-band delta block (3 lags x 4 transforms x 20 ch + cube fut 20 = 260 dim). v22 had silently removed it (never measured) and baseline drifted from 0.0760 to 0.0749. Restoring should bring v16's 0.0760 back. v17-v21, v23-v25 all hurt or noise and removed.

subject: patient1
description: LEAN v26 + SAFE (additive, no-division) version of v27's literature block. v27 used z-score division by sigma.clamp(1e-3) -> blow-up (train 0.30 / test 0.041). v28 replaces z with simple deviation. (a) RELATIVE log_f0 = (log_f0 - voiced_running_mean)*v_gate at taus 90,200 frames; per tau: rel + dt+/dt- = 6 dim (Chang 2017). (b) CONTRASTIVE FORMANTS (f1,f2,f12_diff) - running mean at taus 90,200 = 6 dim (Sjerps/Chang 2019). (c) peakRate + peakTrough + silence_onset + peakRate_sm = 4 dim (Oganian/Chang 2019, Hamilton/Chang). Total +16 dim on v26 baseline 0.0760. Keep if delta>=-0.0008.

subject: patient1
description: v28 KEPT (test_corr 0.0761 vs v26 0.0760, +16 dim, gain-per-dim positive). v29 adds SYLLABLE-RATE CONTEXT block (+5 dim): leaky-low-passed instantaneous rate of (peakRate>0) at taus 15/30/60 frames + (silence_onset>0) at taus 30/60 frames. Captures speech rhythm / syllable rate, distinct from sparse events themselves and continuous loudness. Total stack now +21 dim vs v26. Keep if test_corr >= ~0.0753 (delta >= -0.0008 vs v28 0.0761).

subject: patient1
description: v28 KEPT (0.0761 vs v26 0.0760), v29 KEPT (0.0759, -0.0002, within noise, +5 dim). v30 adds VOICING-GATED NONLINEAR INTERACTIONS (+8 dim): d_log_f0*v_gate (+/-), peakRate*hnr_db (onset x periodicity NEW), peakRate*v_gate (voiced syllable nucleus), peakRate*(1-v_gate) (unvoiced consonant onset), best_strength*long_loud, f12_diff*v_gate. Ridge cannot construct products of features so these add genuinely new info. v21 tried 34-dim variant +0.0000; this is a tighter 8-dim subset emphasizing the new peakRate*HNR interaction. Total stack +29 dim vs v26. Keep if >=0.0753.

subject: patient1
description: v28 (+16d) 0.0761, v29 (+5d) 0.0759, v30 (+8d) 0.0758 - all within noise floor and kept. v31 adds BAND-SEGMENTED SPECTRAL FLUX (+12 dim): per-band sums of ReLU(d_log_e) split into lo/mid/hi (3 bands) x {pos, neg, abs} + lag-3 pos = 12 dim. The existing broadband flux sums ReLU ACROSS all bands; band-restricted ReLU sums add genuinely new nonlinear info (e.g. high-band positive flux = fricative/burst, low-band = voiced onset). Total +41 dim vs v26 0.0760. Keep if >=0.0750.

subject: patient1
description: v28-v31 cumulative: 0.0761,0.0759,0.0758,0.0758 - all within noise floor and kept (each small block <=12 dim). v32 adds MULTI-DURATION SILENCE-GATED ONSETS (+6 dim). The existing silence_onset uses recent_silence tau~6 (~200ms). Hamilton/Chang posterior-STG onset zone is selective for PHRASE boundaries (>300ms, ~600ms silence). Add 3 silence-duration scales: 130/300/600 ms (tau=4/9/18 frames) with peakRate gated by each, plus smoothed copies = 6 dim. Total +47 dim vs v26 0.0760. Keep if >=0.0750.

subject: patient1
description: v28-v32 cumulative: 0.0761/0.0759/0.0758/0.0758/0.0755 - within noise. v33 adds PER-BAND-GROUP PEAK-RATE (+7 dim). Broadband peakRate is on long_loud (mean over all 20 bands). STG is spectrotopic so band-specific onset events carry phoneme info (hi=fricative/sibilant, lo=voiced stops). Compute peakRate landmarks separately on lo/mid/hi band-group loudness with smoothed copies (6 dim) + broadband peakAcc (2nd derivative onset) (1 dim). Total +54 dim vs v26 0.0760. Keep if delta>=-0.0008 vs v32.

subject: patient1
description: v28-v33 cumulative: 0.0761/0.0759/0.0758/0.0758/0.0755/0.0755. v34 adds SCALAR POWER-LAW DEVIATION block (+8 dim): power-law (beta=0.6, L=180=6s) smoothed long_loud/long_centroid/hnr_db/best_strength + their deviation. Multi-second scale-free normalization (NO single tau), distinct from 60/150-frame leaky EMAs. v19 tried per-band +40 dim +0.0002; this is the scalar version. Total +62 dim. Keep if >=0.0747.

subject: patient1
description: v28-v34 cumulative: 0.0761/0.0759/0.0758/0.0758/0.0755/0.0755/0.0752. v35 adds HIGH-RESOLUTION (40-band) PHONETIC FEATURES (+9 dim). The existing 20-band cochleagram is too coarse for phoneme distinctions. Use fb_fine (unused 40-band gammatone on 4096 win) to compute compact phoneme-targeted features: 4 sub-band energies (lo/lomid/midhi/hi), 2 sub-band peak sharpnesses, sibilant-sharp, nasal-resonance, hi-band peak loc. Total +71 dim vs v26. Keep if >=0.0744.
